name: rubik_mono_one
description: Rubik is a sans serif font family with slightly rounded corners designed by Philipp Hubert and Sebastian Fischer at Hubert & Fischer as part of the Chrome Cube Lab project. Rubik Mono One is a monospaced sister of the Black roman style in the Rubik family, which has 5 weights.
